# Join

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Match rows of two tables on key columns. Right-hand columns get the prefix.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "join", "name": "join", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "left"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `left` | `table` | one edge |
| `right` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `how` | `menu` | `"inner"` | `inner`, `left`, `cross` |
| `leftKey` | `column` | `""` |  |
| `rightKey` | `column` | `""` |  |
| `leftKey2` | `column` | `""` |  |
| `rightKey2` | `column` | `""` |  |
| `prefix` | `string` | `"r_"` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `out` | `table` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
